# Description

The objective of this feature request is to address the latency issues associated with the updating of the Avatar, Friend, and World favourite lists within the menu.

# Proposed Implementation

The introduction of a manual refresh button on the Avatar, Friend, and World favourite pages is suggested. This would allow users to manually update these lists. To mitigate potential API costs, a time limit could be imposed on the frequency of refreshes.

# Rationale

The current system does not provide real-time updates to the aforementioned menus. As a result, users often experience delays of several minutes or even require a game restart to view the most recent changes.

For instance, changes such as updating an avatar name or uploading a new avatar do not immediately reflect on the Uploaded page. Similarly, when managing avatars, friends, and worlds via the VRChat website or third-party tools, these changes are not instantaneously updated in the game.

At present, viewing these changes typically necessitates a game restart, a waiting period of a few minutes, or manually unfavoriting/favoriting an item in the game to refresh the menu.

This latency issue poses significant inconvenience for avatar creators, world explorers, and users who utilize third-party tools to manage their VRChat relationships.
title: Enhancement of Avatar, Friend, and World Favourite List Refresh Mechanism
